info.name: EduPlatform API v1 - Complete Feature Tests
info.description: Complete Postman collection for the current Laravel API v1. Covers authentication, registration, profile, content CRUD, PDF upload and student access, question reports, explanation videos, notifications, and dashboards. Seed the database and log in as a teacher first. Select a local PDF file for the upload request. Google login and password reset require valid external credentials/OTP.

request.description: On local environment, the API returns the OTP in data. Elsewhere, enter the emailed code in registration_otp.

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set("registration_token", d.registration_token); if (d.otp) pm.collectionVariables.set("registration_otp", d.otp);

request.description: Run after steps 1 and 2. If the OTP is not returned in local development, enter the received code in registration_otp.

exec: if (pm.collectionVariables.get("registration_otp")) { pm.test("OTP registration succeeds", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().success).to.eql(true); }); pm.collectionVariables.set("otp_student_token", pm.response.json().data.token); } else { pm.test("OTP is required outside local environment", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); }); }

request.description: Optional or environment-dependent request; follow the setup notes and provide a valid token, OTP, or local file when required.

item.name: Google login (optional; real ID token required)

request.description: Optional: set google_id_token to a valid Google ID token; the API verifies it with Google.

exec: if (pm.collectionVariables.get("google_id_token")) { pm.test("Google login succeeds", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().success).to.eql(true); }); pm.collectionVariables.set("google_token", pm.response.json().data.token); } else { pm.test("Google token is required", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); }); }

request.description: Optional or environment-dependent request; follow the setup notes and provide a valid token, OTP, or local file when required.
Run after requesting a reset and setting a valid email OTP in password_reset_otp.

exec: if (pm.collectionVariables.get("password_reset_otp")) { pm.test("Password reset succeeds", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().success).to.eql(true); }); } else { pm.test("Password reset OTP is required", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); }); }

item.name: Upload PDF (select a local PDF file)

request.description: Select a real PDF file in the file field before sending; maximum size is 20 MB.

exec: pm.test("Unpublished course returns 404", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); }); pm.test("API error envelope", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().success).to.eql(false); });
pm.test("PDF response has a content type", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.include("application/pdf"); });

item.name: Filter question dashboard by course and lesson

request.description: The request must use external_id as required by the current FormRequest.

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; const rows = d.data || []; if (rows.length) pm.collectionVariables.set("notification_id", rows[0].id);
